approval: Not Cosmo-approved. Do not treat these clips as Approved.

anchor_source.note: Daylight 16:9 masters were read as clip anchors only. They were not rewritten and are not part of this pack. Night Approved masters were not modified.

weather_gate_rule: Mostly clear daylight means is_day 1, precipitation 0, WMO code 0 or 1, and cloud cover at most 40 percent. Otherwise the weather gate is closed. A passing gate still cannot be filmed here, so the clip is shipped from the daylight still and labeled live capture blocked.
provenance: Candidate 360 clips for daylight scenes NL-01-089 through NL-01-098. Each clip is 10.0s, 864x1080, 24fps, 4:5. The 190px label bar was cropped off the genuine Part A daylight 16:9 master and the center 864x1080 photo is frame 0. Generated views at about 60, 120, and 180 degrees sit at 0s, 3s, 6s, and 9s and are joined by ffmpeg minterpolate optical flow. The 180-degree view is held through 10.0s so the last frame is that key. Not a field capture. Not a drift-only push-in. In-between frames can ghost. Not Cosmo-approved.
figure_note: 60/120/180 keys were checked and regenerated when a description still showed a person. Frame 0 is the daylight crop and can still contain people who were already in that master. NL-01-092 120 and 180 and NL-01-094 120 and NL-01-095 180 were empty retries.
